caseName: Metropolitan Edison Co. v. Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission
caseNameFull: Metropolitan Edison Co. v. Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission

opinions.text: Commw. Ct. Pa. Motions of Edison Electric Institute; Electrical Engineers, Scientists, and Economists; and Energy Association of Pennsylvania for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Certiorari denied. Justice Alito took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and this petition.
